envelope.description: Build the GitHub adapter core and loadTracker

body.title: Build the GitHub adapter core and loadTracker
body.summary: Implement the GitHub adapter factory bound to one owner and repo: kind, capabilities {claim, issue-create}, whoAmI (converting the thrown 'no login' error to missing-signin), findIssue with first-result selection and failure kept distinct from not found, createIssue wrapping the detailed create, and the signoff methods returning rejected without running gh. Add loadTracker that applies the strict resolver, the gh and sign-in checks and the capability check.
acceptanceChecks: loadTracker succeeds when every needed capability is declared and names a missing capability, a missing gh tool and a missing sign-in distinctly when it refuses
whoAmI returns the login and converts the empty-login throw to missing-signin
findIssue returns the first of several matches, ok with null for none and ok:false for a failed lookup
signoff-request and completion are undeclared and the signoff methods run no gh command

tests.name: src/workflow/tracker/__tests__/port.test.ts: loadTracker succeeds when every needed capability is declared
src/workflow/tracker/__tests__/port.test.ts: loadTracker with an empty needed set validates configuration and sign-in
src/workflow/tracker/__tests__/port.test.ts: loadTracker refuses a needed signoff-request capability naming it
src/workflow/tracker/__tests__/port.test.ts: loadTracker names gh as the missing tool
src/workflow/tracker/__tests__/github-adapter.test.ts: whoAmI success, empty login converted to missing-signin, missing tool, missing sign-in and unreachable
src/workflow/tracker/__tests__/github-adapter.test.ts: findIssue returns the first of several matches and separates failure from not found
src/workflow/tracker/__tests__/github-adapter.test.ts: signoff methods return rejected without running gh
